GameItemType.Description: A legendary elven weapon that fires arrows of pure, crackling force. It never seems to miss its mark.
A thick, unyielding bow made of black yew. Its stopping power and range are unmatched.
Carved from the rib of a forgotten beast. The arrows it looses ignite mid-flight.
Strung with metallic thread, this nearly weightless bow strikes with blinding speed.
A massive, metallic construct of a bow. Devastating, but cumbersome.

GameModifier.Provides: Allows the wielder to strike for double normal Attack

GameItemType.Description: The favored tool of elite scouts, its dark wood blends into shadows to grant evasion.
Carved from a tree watered by battlefields. Enchanted arrows strike fear in the enemy.
Strung with silk from an otherworldly arachnid. Its impacts frost over targets.
Forged in moonlight. Fires incorporeal silver shafts that bypass physical armor.
An engineered compound weapon that allows for impossible trick shots in the dark.
A magical weapon that requires no quiver, drawing shafts of pure glowing force.
